Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Decreased Its Holding in Baidu (BIDU) as Valuation Declined; Trb Advisors LP Stake in Apple (AAPL) Decreased by $7.61 Million 
April 17, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson 
Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Inc decreased its stake in Baidu Inc (BIDU) by 6.31% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Inc sold 2,304 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.38% with the market. The institutional investor held 34,220 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.02 million, down from 36,524 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Liberty Mutual Group Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Baidu Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $80.04B market cap company. The stock increased 0.76% or $1.73 during the last trading session, reaching $229.9. About 1.79M shares traded. Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ:BIDU) has risen 36.72% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.17% the S&P500. 
Trb Advisors Lp decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 50% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Trb Advisors Lp sold 45,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 45,000 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.62M, down from 90,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trb Advisors Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $892.11 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.62% or $1.09 during the last trading session, reaching $175.82. About 20.26M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.

After $3.89 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
